subject.title: Enhancement: Developer experience quick wins from code analysis

question: Where, if anywhere, should OpenClaw expose that an explicit skill command was converted into a model-directed request rather than dispatched as a tool?
rationale: The routing is intentional and documented, so selecting its permanent visibility level is a product and operator-experience choice rather than a correctness repair.

options.title: Debug or trace diagnostic
options.body: Emit a structured diagnostic only when tracing or debug logging is enabled, preserving normal chat output while making routing inspectable.

options.title: Always-visible warning
options.body: Show a one-line notice for every model-routed skill command, maximizing visibility at the cost of routine output noise.

options.title: Documentation only
options.body: Keep runtime behavior silent and rely on the existing skills documentation to explain the tool-dispatch distinction.

recommendation.title: Debug or trace diagnostic
recommendation.body: Emit a structured diagnostic only when tracing or debug logging is enabled, preserving normal chat output while making routing inspectable.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is connected to the relevant current-main history and supplied the prior product-context review retaining the question.
